map._capabilityRequest: THREE THINGS, all of them copy-layer instrumentation (D13) and NONE of them a change to the block under test, so contract 9.1 is not engaged. (a) SEVENTEEN READBACKS. Every assertion in the enumeration names co-observation signals as well as a response, and for this subject most of them are the INPUTS the head itself drives - the two limit switches, the pressure switch, the pack feedback, the hopper level, the two shredder feedbacks, the operator mode and the three operator command bits - plus the plant pre-start sounder output and, NEW SINCE THE REGISTER NAMED THEM, the four pusher alarm bits DB_Alarms.ShredderAlarm0.%X3 to .%X6. The binding's resultSources carry none of them: it was derived with the pusher's own instance as the observed block. THE READBACKS ARE NOT REDUNDANT WITH THE COMMANDS: the head's own network 20 comment records that the injection array is shared between heads and that the last head to run wins every index it touches, and that a neighbouring head has already been measured driving a shared index while reading as idle. A readback is the only thing that turns 'we commanded it' into 'the block saw it'. *** THE FOUR ALARM BITS ARE A WORD BIT SLICE, WHICH IS THE ONE THING IN THIS REQUEST THAT MAY NOT BE MECHANICALLY POSSIBLE - see `_theAnnunciationDecision`. *** (b) OCCURRENCE LATCHES, armed by iDB_PusherStim.Stim.Armed, on the nine signals this set observes in Latched mode. The generator already emits exactly this shape for slot HBA - FC_HarnessCopyLayer network 8, SCOIL gated on the start bool and the stimulus model's Armed flag, RCOIL on the start bool falling - so this is more of an existing rung, not a new mechanism. (c) TWO VIOLATION LATCHES, named below, each latching a conjunction that no single-signal latch can express. FB_HarnessViolationLatch (block 9003) already exists and does precisely this for the hopper's four; these two are two more networks in the same shape, reading only what the monitored block publishes on its own interface and the head's Armed flag. ALSO REQUESTED, and trivially: the four fault SOURCE latches iDB_PusherControl.IO.Blocked / BothSwitchesFault / EndTravelTimeoutFault / ParkedTimeoutFault, which the binding already carries as resultSources and which only need publishing.

vectors._scenario: The impossible position. The factual half is verified and true - `converter cross-check` reports DB_Alarms.ShredderAlarm0.%X3..%X6 as SOLE WRITERS, each written by one network of FC_AlarmsMain as a single unconditional COIL, and Main calls that FC unconditionally.
